grammar.title: 亲身的经历
lines: We had spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity. These attracted many visitors, for they were not only of great architectural interest, but contained a large number of beautifully preserved frescoes as well . of + 名词 描述人或事物的特征 These attracted many visitors, for they were not only of great architectural interest, … These attracted many visitors, for they were not only architecturally interesting, ... contain （也可表示建筑物里的包含） The Imperial Palace attracts many visitors, for it is not only of great architectural interest, but contains a large number of beautifully preserved historical relics as well .故宫吸引了很多游客，因为它不但在建筑方面很有趣，而且里面有大量的保存完好的文物。 On the day before our departure, several bus loads of tourists descended on the town. The day after the birth of the five children, an aeroplane arrived in Aberdeen bringing sixty reporters and photographers . load （量词）装载量；容纳量 This was more than we could bear , so we decided to spend our last day exploring the countryside. be more than … can / could... 是…不能承受的 Taking a path which led out of the town , we crossed a few fields until we came to a dense wood. take v. 英文解释：use (a road, path, etc) as a route to go to a place 取道… lead v. 英文解释：to go in a particular direction or to a particular place 通往… We expected the path to end abruptly, but we found that it traced its way through the trees . trace / weave / wind one’s way 蜿蜒前进 We tramped through the wood for over two hours until we arrived at a deep stream. tramp through 跋涉穿过 We could see that the path continued on the other side , but we had no idea how we could get across the stream . （have no idea / not have any idea）+（that / how / what / why / which / where …） 表达不知道 Suddenly my wife spotted a boat moored to the bank. moor v. 停泊 moor … to …把…停泊在… In it there was a boatman fast asleep . be fast / sound asleep 熟睡 We gently woke him up and asked him to ferry us to the other side. ferry n. 渡船；渡口 ferry v. to carry people or goods between two or more places 运送（人或货物） Though he was reluctant to do so at first , we eventually persuaded him to take us. be reluctant / unwilling to do sth. 不愿意做某事

sentences.title: 寂静岭
lines: The path led to a tiny village perched on the steep sides of a mountain. be perched on … 位于（比较高、危险）的地方 The place consisted of a straggling unmade road which was lined on either side by small houses . straggle v. grow or spread in an irregular or untidy manner 无规则地或散乱地生长或散布 line vt. form a line along sth. 沿某物排成行 Even under a clear blue sky, the village looked forbidding, as all the houses were built of grey mud bricks. forbidding adj.（外表）冷峻的，令人生畏的；令人厌恶的；险恶的 The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby. 形容词 +（连字符）+ looking 表示“看起来怎么样的” on 用…拴着 length （量词）一根、一节… tie v. 系绳子 nearby adv. 在附近 并列形式 不如独立主格简洁，重点不突出 The village seemed deserted, and the only sign of life was an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby. Sitting down on a dilapidated wooden fence near the field, we opened a couple of tins of sardines and had a picnic lunch . 非谓动词做状语（源自句型简化） All at once, I noticed that my wife seemed to be filled with alarm . all at once 突然= suddenly = all of a sudden alarm n. a feeling of fear or worry because sth. bad or dangerous might happen 惊慌，恐慌 be filled with anger / fear / dread / horror / joy / happiness / doubt / alarm / revulsion / admiration / remorse … 充满了某种情绪… Looking up I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently as we ate . be surrounded by 被…包围 We offered them food and spoke to them kindly, but they remained motionless. offer sb. sth. 给某人某事 I concluded that they were simply shy of strangers . be shy of … 对…腼腆羞怯；害怕…… When we later walked down the main street of the village, we were followed by a silent procession of children. … a silent procession of children …（silent修饰的是procession不是children）名词前有量词修饰 形容词放在量词前，而不放在名词前 The village which had seemed deserted , immediately came to life. come to life to become more interesting, exciting or full of activity 变活跃起来 Faces appeared at windows. 地道表达：传神、形象 people looked out of the window. 普通 Men in shirt sleeves stood outside their houses and glared at us. in shirt sleeves / shirt-sleeves dressed informally without wearing anything, such as a jacket, over a shirt 只穿衬衣的（不正式） Old women in black shawls peered at us from doorways. peer at 凝视，盯着看 The most frightening thing of all was that not a sound could be heard . There was no doubt that we were unwelcome visitors . there is no doubt / question that ... 毫无疑问的是… We needed no further warning. further far的比较级“更多的，进一步的” Turning back down the main street, we quickened our pace and made our way rapidly towards the stream where we hoped the boatman was waiting . Turning back down the main street, we quickened our pace and made our way rapidly towards the stream, and we hoped that the boatman was waiting there . 相当于是个并列句 quicken one’s pace 加快步伐 make one’s way 前往某地 嵌入式定语从句 本身是定语从句修饰先行词，另一方面又是主谓结构的宾语 In this part of the cave, they could hear an insistent booming sound which they found was caused by a small waterspout shooting down into a pool from the roof of the cave .
For one agonizing moment, the dish was perched precariously on the bank of the canal, but it suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water .
